data_contract.reason: v3p3 adds the documented event-level furrow tire-compaction predictor to the Bayesian and ML runoff-volume models only; the corrected 528-event input and v3p1 preflight contract are unchanged

furrow_tire_compaction.timing: after residue measurement and before the first runoff event
furrow_tire_compaction.carryover: none; the indicator applies to runoff events in the documented treatment-year

seasonal_stir.definition: sum treatment-specific STIR after the preceding crop's named harvest operation through the runoff observation date
seasonal_stir.same_day_rule: the named harvest operation closes the preceding crop; other operations recorded on that HarvestDate carry into the following crop
seasonal_stir.first_observed_season: left-censored because the preceding 2010 HarvestDate is unavailable; includes all STIR records available through each 2011 observation
seasonal_stir.bayesian_v3p3_usage: Season_STIR_toDate is used for runoff-volume and concentration; residue uses post-harvest seasonal STIR accumulated through the actual residue measurement date when known and PlantDate otherwise
seasonal_stir.ml_v3p3_usage: both Season_STIR_toDate and CumAll_STIR_toDate are candidate features in concentration and runoff-volume models; FurrowTireCompaction is a candidate feature in runoff volume only

corrected_roster.irrigation_roster_rule: derive distinct Irrigation labels independently within each Year

hierarchy: sum physical-event values within Year + Treatment + Rep + Analyte + Draw
average replicate-specific annual plot totals within Year + Treatment + Analyte + Draw

storm_handling.bayesian: retained as distinct Irrigation levels and mapped to numeric codes 11 and 12 for the existing linear irrigation-effect term
storm_handling.ml: retained as distinct categorical Irrigation levels
storm_handling.limitation: Bayes v3p3 and ML v3p3 retain framework-specific storm representations; they are not harmonized
